newsitem.title: USA: Control Data introduces server product.
newsitem.headline: Control Data introduces server product.

text.p: Control Data Systems Inc said Monday it introduced a new computer server product that allows for real-time information updates across various dissimilar directories.

The company said the Rialto Global Directory/Meta Edition allows such businesses as retailers or distributors to update several product pricing and product availability databases simultaneously. Other types of system updates take as much as eight hours, Control Data said.
The Rialto product, which has a base price of $8,000 per server for one to 1,000 users, will be available by mid-1997, the company said.
Control Data is a software development company.
Its shares were up 5/8 Monday at 15-5/8.
